name: campustest-pro
description: CampusTest Pro monorepo for college assessment delivery and administration.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/code-runner-contracts && npm run build --workspace packages/language-registry && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/worker && npm run build --workspace apps/code-runner-gateway
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace packages/code-runner-contracts && npm run lint --workspace packages/language-registry && npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run lint --workspace apps/worker && npm run lint --workspace apps/code-runner-gateway
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/code-runner-contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/language-registry && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/code-runner-gateway
scripts.db:migrate:status: npm --workspace apps/api exec prisma migrate status
scripts.docker:build: docker build -f Dockerfile.api -t campustest-api:local . && docker build -f Dockerfile.web -t campustest-web:local . && docker build -f Dockerfile.worker -t campustest-worker:local . && docker build -f apps/code-runner-gateway/Dockerfile -t campustest-code-runner-gateway:local .
